1.web: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
1.asv: O Jehovah, rebuke me not in thy wrath; Neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

2.web: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
2.asv: For thine arrows stick fast in me, And thy hand presseth me sore.

3.web: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
3.asv: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine indignation; Neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

4.web: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
4.asv: For mine iniquities are gone over my head: As a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

5.web: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.
5.asv: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, Because of my foolishness.

6.web: I am pained and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
6.asv: I am pained and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

7.web: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
7.asv: For my loins are filled with burning; And there is no soundness in my flesh.

8.web: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
8.asv: I am faint and sore bruised: I have groaned by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

9.web: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
9.asv: Lord, all my desire is before thee; And my groaning is not hid from thee.

10.web: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
10.asv: My heart throbbeth, my strength faileth me: As for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

11.web: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
11.asv: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague; And my kinsmen stand afar off.

12.web: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
12.asv: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; And they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, And meditate deceits all the day long.

13.web: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
13.asv: But I, as a deaf man, hear not; And I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

14.web: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
14.asv: Yea, I am as a man that heareth not, And in whose mouth are no reproofs.

15.web: For in you, Yahweh, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.
15.asv: For in thee, O Jehovah, do I hope: Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.

16.web: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
16.asv: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

17.web: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
17.asv: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.

18.web: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
18.asv: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

19.web: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
19.asv: But mine enemies are lively, and are strong; And they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

20.web: They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
20.asv: They also that render evil for good Are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.

21.web: Don’t forsake me, Yahweh. My God, don’t be far from me.
21.asv: Forsake me not, O Jehovah: O my God, be not far from me.

22.web: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
22.asv: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
